title: girardinia suborbiculata subsp. triloba
intro: Girardinia suborbiculata subsp. triloba, commonly known as the Chinese Chrysanthemum or Trilobed Chrysanthemum, is a plant species in the family Compositae. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Girardinia suborbiculata subsp. triloba include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and treating digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
